The field that decides the kind.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M606,178 C606,219 266,219 266,260"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M266,298 C266,339 181,339 181,380"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M266,298 C266,339 351,339 351,380"/><a href="../contracts/what-the-code-is/"><rect class="cm-box" x="190" y="260" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="266" y="283" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">codeHash</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>One account can hold both, because the two fields are independent.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M96,298 C96,339 181,339 181,380"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M266,298 C266,339 181,339 181,380"/><a href="../accounts/accounts/#so-one-account-can-hold-code-and-storage"><rect class="cm-box" x="105" y="380" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="181" y="403" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Code and storage</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>balance is the same field for both kinds. Code can own money.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M436,178 C436,219 436,219 436,260"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M96,178 C96,219 436,219 436,260"/><a href="../accounts/accounts/#and-yes-a-contract-can-hold-ether"><rect class="cm-box" x="360" y="260" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="436" y="283" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Contracts hold ether</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>One field answers it — an empty codeHash means no code, so no contract.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M266,298 C266,339 351,339 351,380"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M96,178 C96,279 351,279 351,380"/><a href="../accounts/accounts/#which-kind-is-it-look-at-one-field"><rect class="cm-box" x="275" y="380" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="351" y="403" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Which kind is it?</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>The address is the key into the state. The address is not the account.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M521,58 C521,69 521,69 521,80"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M181,58 C181,69 521,69 521,80"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M521,118 C521,159 351,159 351,200"/><a href="../accounts/accounts/#how-an-address-finds-an-account"><rect class="cm-box" x="445" y="80" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="521" y="103" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Finding the entry</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>The lookup key is the hash of the address, so nobody picks where they land.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M521,118 C521,159 351,159 351,200"/><a href="../accounts/accounts/#why-hash-the-address-first"><rect class="cm-box" x="275" y="200" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="351" y="223" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">keccak256(address)</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>An entry appears the moment something is put at an address. No act of creation.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M436,178 C436,219 606,219 606,260"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,58 C351,159 606,159 606,260"/><a href="../accounts/accounts/#nothing-creates-an-account"><rect class="cm-box" x="530" y="260" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="606" y="283" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Nothing creates one</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>Nothing happens by itself. Every chain of execution begins with a signature.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M181,118 C181,219 351,219 351,320"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M96,178 C96,249 351,249 351,320"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,358 C351,369 521,369 521,380"/><a href="../accounts/accounts/#only-an-eoa-can-start-anything"><rect class="cm-box" x="275" y="320" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="351" y="343" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Only an EOA starts</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>Balances make a signed transaction reusable, which is the hole the counter fills.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M266,178 C266,279 521,279 521,380"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,358 C351,369 521,369 521,380"/><a href="../accounts/accounts/#why-this-design-needs-a-nonce"><rect class="cm-box" x="445" y="380" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="521" y="403" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Why it needs a nonce</text></a></g></svg></section><section class="cm-zoom" id="zoom-accounts-nonce"><p class="cm-zoomhead"><strong>Inside The nonce</strong> — 9 concepts, 11 lines, and 3 dashed boxes borrowed from earlier pages. Every box is a link. <a href="../accounts/nonce/">Open the page</a> · <a href="#the-map">Back to the map</a></p><svg class="cm-svg cm-zoomsvg" viewBox="0 0 702 378" role="group" aria-label="The 9 class="cm-edge" d="M351,118 C351,129 181,129 181,140"/><path class="cm-edge cm-crossing" d="M351,58 C351,99 181,99 181,140"/><path class="cm-edge" d="M181,178 C181,189 181,189 181,200"/><path class="cm-edge" d="M181,178 C181,189 351,189 351,200"/><path class="cm-edge" d="M351,238 C351,249 351,249 351,260"/><path class="cm-edge" d="M351,298 C351,309 351,309 351,320"/><path class="cm-edge" d="M351,118 C351,129 351,129 351,140"/><path class="cm-edge cm-crossing" d="M521,58 C521,99 351,99 351,140"/><path class="cm-edge" d="M351,118 C351,129 521,129 521,140"/><path class="cm-edge" d="M521,178 C521,189 521,189 521,200"/><g class="cm-node cm-outside"><title>From Accounts — Every account, of either kind, holds exactly these four and nothing else.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M181,58 C181,69 351,69 351,80"/><a href="#zoom-accounts-accounts"><rect class="cm-box" x="105" y="20" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="181" y="43" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">The four fields</text></a></g><g class="cm-node cm-outside"><title>From Accounts — Balances make a signed transaction reusable, which is the hole the counter fills.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,58 C351,99 181,99 181,140"/><a href="#zoom-accounts-accounts"><rect class="cm-box" x="275" y="20" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="351" y="43" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Why it needs a nonce</text></a></g><g class="cm-node cm-outside"><title>From Addresses — Not derived from a key at all — computed from the creator and a counter.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M521,58 C521,99 351,99 351,140"/><a href="#zoom-crypto-addresses"><rect class="cm-box" x="445" y="20" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="521" y="43" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Contract addresses</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>Starts at zero, rises by one per transaction sent. Nothing more.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M181,58 C181,69 351,69 351,80"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,118 C351,129 181,129 181,140"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,118 C351,129 351,129 351,140"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,118 C351,129 521,129 521,140"/><a href="../accounts/nonce/#the-account-nonce-concretely"><rect class="cm-box" x="275" y="80" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="351" y="103" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">The counter itself</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>Without it a signature stays valid, so a payment could be replayed forever.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,118 C351,129 181,129 181,140"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,58 C351,99 181,99 181,140"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M181,178 C181,189 181,189 181,200"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M181,178 C181,189 351,189 351,200"/><a href="../accounts/nonce/#the-problem-it-solves"><rect class="cm-box" x="105" y="140" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="181" y="163" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">The problem it solves</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>Spending a coin consumes it, so there is nothing left to replay.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M181,178 C181,189 181,189 181,200"/><a href="../accounts/nonce/#why-bitcoin-needs-no-such-thing"><rect class="cm-box" x="105" y="200" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="181" y="223" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Why Bitcoin differs</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>No gaps. Nonce 5 waits until 4 is included, however much it pays.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M181,178 C181,189 351,189 351,200"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,238 C351,249 351,249 351,260"/><a href="../accounts/nonce/#strictly-in-order-no-gaps"><rect class="cm-box" x="275" y="200" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="351" y="223" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Strictly in order</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>One cheap transaction low in the queue holds up every later one.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,238 C351,249 351,249 351,260"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,298 C351,309 351,309 351,320"/><a href="../accounts/nonce/#why-transactions-get-stuck"><rect class="cm-box" x="275" y="260" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="351" y="283" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Why they get stuck</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>Replace it at the same nonce — you cannot cancel, only overwrite.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,298 C351,309 351,309 351,320"/><a href="../accounts/nonce/#unsticking-one"><rect class="cm-box" x="275" y="320" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="351" y="343" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Unsticking one</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>For a contract the counter records deployments, not transactions sent.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,118 C351,129 351,129 351,140"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M521,58 C521,99 351,99 351,140"/><a href="../accounts/nonce/#contract-accounts-have-a-nonce-too"><rect class="cm-box" x="275" y="140" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="351" y="163" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">Contracts have one</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>Not secret, not random, not a fee, not a position in a block.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M351,118 C351,129 521,129 521,140"/><path class="cm-halo" d="M521,178 C521,189 521,189 521,200"/><a href="../accounts/nonce/#what-the-nonce-is-not"><rect class="cm-box" x="445" y="140" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="521" y="163" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">What it is not</text></a></g><g class="cm-node"><title>Five unrelated mechanisms share the word. Only this one counts transactions.</title><path class="cm-halo" d="M521,178 C521,189 521,189 521,200"/><a href="../accounts/nonce/#other-things-called-a-nonce"><rect class="cm-box" x="445" y="200" width="152" height="38" rx="5"/><text class="cm-label" x="521" y="223" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">The other nonces</text></a></g></svg></section>
